key_conclusions.conclusion: M3 is a wiring and exposure milestone — backend modules are 55-80% complete, only integration work remains
key_conclusions.evidence: 25+ files examined, all follow 'backend built, not wired' pattern

key_conclusions.conclusion: Three-phase strategy optimally resolves feature dependencies
key_conclusions.evidence: Dependency graph analysis: F5→F1, F2/F6→graph writes, F3/F4 independent

key_conclusions.conclusion: Phase 1 (F1, F3, F7) is low-risk and establishes shared patterns
key_conclusions.evidence: F1/F3 are self-contained, F7 is trivial carry-over, no graph writes needed

key_conclusions.conclusion: Graph engine write operations are the main new infrastructure investment
key_conclusions.evidence: graph-engine.js:932-956 only has read ops, F2 and F6 need plant/hint/harvest/create writes

key_conclusions.conclusion: Structured score transport layer needed to bridge backend per-module scores and frontend 3-score UI
key_conclusions.evidence: critic.js:35-54 maps moduleScores to 3 flat scores, EvaluationPanel.tsx:62-77 renders only 3

key_conclusions.conclusion: Foreshadowing lifecycle (F2) is the key market differentiator
key_conclusions.evidence: No competitor offers plant→hint→harvest lifecycle management. External research confirms.

recommendations.title: Establish MCP endpoint registration pattern in Phase 1
recommendations.rationale: All 7 features need MCP endpoints. Standardizing the pattern in Phase 1 (F1, F3) gives Phase 2/3 a template.
steps: Create endpoint registration helper following existing graph.js/critic.js pattern
Register F1 evaluator endpoints + F3 style transport endpoint
Document pattern for Phase 2/3 features

recommendations.title: Build structured score transport layer
recommendations.rationale: Backend has per-module scores from 10 evaluators. Frontend needs structured data. Replace flat 3-score mapping.
steps: Define score transport interface (per-module + aggregate)
Update critic.js to transport structured scores alongside existing 3-score fallback
Update src/api/evaluation.ts with new structured endpoint
Upgrade EvaluationPanel.tsx to consume per-module data

recommendations.title: Wire WritingStyle 8D to backend prompt builder
recommendations.rationale: 340-line 8D style system outputs flat string. Backend prompt builder should consume structured style.
steps: Update WritingStyle.ts to export structured style object alongside flat string
Create style transport API endpoint
Update writing.js to consume structured style object for prompt assembly

recommendations.title: Build graph engine write operations
recommendations.rationale: F2 (foreshadowing) and F6 (character) need create/update/delete operations on graph. Currently read-only.
steps: Add write methods to graph-engine.js (createNode, updateNode, deleteNode, createRelation)
Add validation + concurrency protection
Wire write operations to MCP endpoints
Integration test with existing VectorSearch embedding support

recommendations.title: Wire ForeshadowingManager lifecycle to endpoints + UI
recommendations.rationale: 662-line lifecycle manager is fully functional but zero endpoint exposure. Key market differentiator.
steps: Create foreshadowing MCP endpoints (plant, hint, harvest, stats)
Create frontend API functions in src/api/knowledge.ts
Build foreshadowing lifecycle UI panel (replacing minimal status filter)
Integrate with graph engine write ops for persistence

recommendations.title: Resolve M2 deferred items (F7)
recommendations.rationale: Mandatory carry-over: ISS-066 (L5 interrupt edge case), HV-001 (fastembed e2e), F-001 (1-line cleanup).
steps: Fix L5 executeChain interrupt currentUnitIndex preservation
Add manual fastembed e2e test with model availability check
Remove dead renameSkill import in SkillTab.tsx

recommendations.title: Build Character Depth UI with per-module profile panel
recommendations.rationale: CharacterManager + CharacterDepthSystem fully built. Need endpoints + profile UI panel.
steps: Create character depth MCP endpoints
Create frontend API functions
Enhance CharacterTab.tsx with depth profile panel (personality, motivation, growth, relationships)

recommendations.title: Upgrade Consistency Dashboard with per-module scores
recommendations.rationale: Cross-chapter consistency check works but UI shows only 3 flat scores. Per-module view enhances usability.
steps: Update consistency endpoint to include per-module breakdown
Upgrade EvaluationPanel or create new ConsistencyPanel component
Add per-module drill-down UI

recommendations.title: Wire NarrativePatternDetector + WritingSessionCluster to analysis endpoints
recommendations.rationale: Stretch goal. Built but never imported. Adds unique analytics capability.
steps: Create analysis MCP endpoints (pattern detection, session clustering)
Create frontend API + analysis UI panel
Integrate with HybridSearch for pattern-based search

decision_trail.reason: Phase 1 establishes shared infrastructure, Phase 2 builds on it, Phase 3 is independent stretch

decision_trail.decision: Graph engine write ops as shared infrastructure
decision_trail.context: F2 and F6 both need graph write operations
decision_trail.chosen: Build write ops as Phase 2 shared infrastructure, not per-feature
decision_trail.reason: Avoids duplication, single validation layer, consistent behavior

decision_trail.context: Frontend expects 3 flat scores, backend has per-module scores
decision_trail.chosen: Transport both structured + flat scores, progressive UI upgrade
decision_trail.reason: Never break backward compatibility — existing UI works during migration

implementation_scope.objective: Phase 1: Foundation Wiring — evaluator expansion + style integration + M2 deferrals
implementation_scope.rationale: Establishes MCP endpoint pattern and structured transport layer for Phase 2/3
acceptance_criteria: 5 dormant evaluators registered and producing per-module scores
Structured style object consumed by backend prompt builder
M2 deferred items resolved (ISS-066, HV-001, F-001)
New per-module score data available via API

implementation_scope.objective: Phase 2: Rich Exposure — foreshadowing lifecycle + consistency dashboard + character depth
implementation_scope.rationale: High-value features that depend on Phase 1 infrastructure
acceptance_criteria: Graph engine supports write operations (create/update/delete) with validation
Character depth profile accessible via API
Consistency dashboard shows per-module score breakdown
VectorSearch integration works for character + foreshadow entities

implementation_scope.objective: Phase 3: Analytics — narrative pattern detection + writing session clustering
implementation_scope.rationale: Independent stretch goal with unique analytics value
acceptance_criteria: Narrative pattern detection endpoint returns categorized patterns
Writing session clustering groups sessions by style similarity
Analysis results consumable by frontend UI
